register.labelZh: WHIP 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: whip something out 可以描述某人立即拿出手機、卡或車票等物件。；whip through something 可以描述迅速完成表格、問題、訊息和其他工作。；whip somebody up 可以描述音樂、演說或活動如何令群眾極度興奮。；whip something up 適合描述某人在短時間內準備簡單餐點或小食。
register.summaryEn: Whip something out helps you describe someone producing an object immediately, such as a phone, card or ticket. Whip through something is useful for describing the quick completion of forms, questions, messages and other tasks. Whip somebody up helps you describe how music, speeches or events make a crowd extremely excited. Whip something up is useful when someone prepares a simple meal or snack in a short time.
